title: International Rules Series 2017
metaDescription: The 2017 International Rules Series was played between Australia and Ireland in Adelaide and Perth under the hybrid code.

overview.about: The International Rules Series is a hybrid contest between Australian rules footballers and Gaelic footballers from Ireland, played under a compromise set of rules with a round ball. A periodic representative series, it is the main international outlet for the otherwise domestic AFL.
overview.nextEvent: The next International Rules Series pits an Australian representative side against Ireland under hybrid rules, alternating hosting between the two nations. It is a rare chance to see AFL stars in international colours.
